How ordering works

No account or card needed. Your order goes straight to our WhatsApp.

  1. Pick your pieces

    Add mekhela sador, sarees or dupattas to your bag. Ask about any handpainted design.

  2. Send your bag on WhatsApp

    One tap sends your list, total and delivery address to us.

  3. Confirm and pay

    We confirm availability, delivery charges and payment details on chat.

  4. We pack and dispatch

    Your order is packed at our studio and sent your way.

Style that speaks, comfort that lasts

ND Attire was founded by Nikita Dutta and specialises in handpainted attire and bridal dupattas. Every painted design starts as a brushstroke on plain fabric, which is why no two pieces are exactly alike.

Alongside the handpainted work, we curate handloom wash cotton, staple cotton and everyday mekhela sador, with special collections for Durga Puja and the wedding season.
